interface.longDescription: Detects what an MCP server project is and walks it through the journey: a new mcp-use server, a migration from the official SDK, MCP Apps views, and ChatGPT or Archestra host checks. Static rules, a live protocol probe, an Archestra Owned App linter, and docs MCP servers for mcp-use, OpenAI and Archestra. Silent in projects that are not MCP servers.
